project_state.authority_rule: The snapshot is a read-only projection. Never infer acceptance, live coverage or intent that is absent from its canonical evidence dimensions.
project_state.name: project-state-recovery-v1
project_state.purpose: Recover current project direction after session start, context compaction or orchestrator handoff without reconstructing the ledger.
steps: call fow_handover operation=project_state_snapshot with project focus
follow exactly one next_gate and provide only its listed required inputs
use detail_references only when the current gate needs more evidence
use a focused snapshot for one milestone, use case, sequence, packet or gate
refresh the snapshot after every material lifecycle mutation
stop_conditions: next_gate is authority_decision_required and no governing decision exists
completeness reports a source required by the current gate as unavailable
the retained snapshot fingerprint differs from a refreshed response

remediation.name: packet-remediation-v2
remediation.purpose: Convert accepted review findings into one ordinary successor packet that uses the normal packet-work-plan-v2 execution path.

retry_policy.new_packet: open a normal successor packet for a reviewed post-run defect
retry_policy.same_run: resume only an in-run provider failure that has not been reviewed as a defect

remediation.schema_rule: Remediation is lifecycle metadata. Never invent a fixing packet schema or a provider path other than codingcastle.impl_packet.v2.
steps: record or select the closed set of unresolved review findings
call fow_packet_author operation=start_packet with purpose=remediation, finding_ids and regression evidence
reuse predecessor scope and invariants unless the successor explicitly narrows them
inspect the result with fow_packet_inspect view=summary
navigate the effective repo or workspace surface through the implementation provider
select recent numbered targets while authoring each affected unit
author or incrementally refine the normal packet-work-plan-v2 plan through fow_packet_author
accept and advance it through fow_packet_advance
validate staged output before apply and resolve findings only from evidence
stop_conditions: a finding is terminal or belongs to another change
the correction has no regression-evidence requirement
the work plan or graph revision is stale
provider completion has not yet been validated

authoring_questions: What exact behavior or contract must change?
Which accepted target owns that change?
What ordered implementation steps must the coder perform there?
Which existing contracts or context must be reused rather than redeclared?
Which predecessor output must exist first?
What cleanup or out-of-scope boundary prevents duplicate or dead work?
What local observable check shows that this unit is complete?
work_plan.instruction_rule: Instructions describe work to perform. Objectives and expected outcomes provide context but never substitute for instructions.

invalid_examples.correction: write ordered technical work the coder must perform
invalid_examples.invalid: instructions contain only the packet objective

invalid_examples.correction: state the behavior and contract changes at the accepted target
invalid_examples.invalid: instructions contain only IDs or symbol names

invalid_examples.correction: select only readable candidate ordinals returned by the same add_unit operation
invalid_examples.invalid: a caller supplies chunk IDs or binding IDs

invalid_examples.correction: keep only unit-local observable checks in unit_checks
invalid_examples.invalid: packet-wide checks copied into every unit

work_plan.name: packet-work-plan-v2

provider_decision_example.rule: choose one mutation ordinal and optional context ordinals from the current fow_packet_advance gate; the provider retains graph identities

work_plan.purpose: Create one packet and author its immutable work plan one unit at a time. Describe existing-code targets semantically; a configured packet provider resolves them later through its own readable choices.
steps: create implementation or remediation through fow_packet_author operation=start_packet
refine missing packet scope or invariants only through the revise_packet action returned by the current gate
define each unit with fow_packet_author operation=add_unit and use target_description for existing code
add further units individually; Flow persists complete immutable plan revisions
inspect the bounded working sheet and current gate with fow_packet_inspect
answer one factual engineering gate through fow_packet_author operation=answer_gate
accept the proposed plan through the exact fow_packet_advance action returned by the gate
call fow_packet_advance for mechanical reconciliation, transient provider target decisions and provider progress
stop at semantic decisions, provider outages or asynchronous boundaries
stop_conditions: an existing-target unit has no semantic target description or no current provider candidate matches it
any unit has empty instructions or unit_checks
the packet or plan revision is stale
a required construction blocker remains unresolved
the configured packet provider does not support the socket contract
the provider reports unresolved or incomplete target evidence

unit_shape.deterministic_deletion: delete_existing selects exactly one current parser symbol; Flow emits no byte range and CodingCastle performs zero model calls
unit_shape.future_destination: new_file and extract_move require file_path. In provider-backed mode omit member_label when the provider can resolve one catalog member; when it presents multiple readable members, use only the selected provider label. Never infer a label from file_path, project ID, active ordering or another local heuristic
unit_shape.target_choice: in provider-backed mode set target_description and do not pass provider identities; fow_packet_advance later presents transient readable ordinals. In agnostic mode only, add_unit may offer Flow-local audited candidates without claiming executability

instructions: Export the process lifecycle and readiness contracts.
Keep the module free of process-launching behavior.
unit_checks: The required public contracts are exported.

instructions: Consume the predecessor contracts without redeclaring them.
Implement bounded process startup and shutdown behavior.
units.target_description: the existing process supervisor lifecycle implementation
unit_checks: Startup and shutdown preserve the declared lifecycle contract.

contract.server_instructions: Flow of Work MCP is a durable software-lifecycle control plane. Call fow_capabilities first, then call fow_what_next for the current project. Use fow_packet_author/inspect/advance for packet work and fow_campaign_author/inspect/advance for verification campaigns. Use fow_get_job only after an asynchronous operation has returned a durable job_id.
